tasks.name: Detection
tasks.desc: Is an earthquake present in a 30-second window? Trained on the 19 stations that stream live, with the P onset anywhere in the window and the old system's own false alarms as hard negatives. Chronological held-out test of 7,303 windows (4,964 events): AUC 0.9998, MCC 0.886; STA/LTA on the same filtered input reaches 0.816.

tasks.name: Magnitude
tasks.desc: Network magnitude from multi-station 3-component traces aligned on picked P arrivals, with distances from the located epicentre. 5-seed ensemble R² 0.951 (MAE 0.10) on 937 held-out events (M2-5.2) vs 0.886 for amplitude + distance; in live-like conditions (10 km location error, 3-6 stations) R² 0.939.

disclaimer: Research prototype on real Southern California network data, not an official warning system. It detects, locates and sizes earthquakes after they begin (rapid detection); predicting whether an earthquake will occur remains unsolved.
